description: This Java class 'ShardRegions' manages creation and retrieval of Akka cluster sharding proxy regions, specifically for policies, things, and connections. It encapsulates logic around starting shard region proxies and providing access to them within an actor system.

classes.name: ShardRegions
classes.description: A utility class providing access to Akka cluster sharding proxies for policies, things, and connections, with methods to create and retrieve these proxies.

methods.name: ShardRegions.of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ShardRegions instance with specified ActorSystem and ClusterConfig.

methods.name: policies
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef for the policies shard region proxy.

methods.name: things
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef for the things shard region proxy.

methods.name: connections
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef for the connections shard region proxy.

methods.name: startProxy
methods.description: Creates and starts a shard region proxy of a given name and cluster role, not cached internally.
